description: This file defines a WPF UserControl named EquationStylePanelControl for managing and displaying equation line styles and colors in a graphing calculator application. It includes dependency properties for color and style selection, methods for retrieving line patterns and automation names, and event handlers for user interactions.

classes.name: EquationStylePanelControl
classes.description: A user control for selecting and displaying equation line styles and colors in a graphing calculator app.

methods.name: EquationStylePanelControl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the control and setting up style options.

methods.name: GetLinePattern
methods.description: Returns a line pattern (DoubleCollection) based on the specified EquationLineStyle.

methods.name: GetLineAutomationName
methods.description: Provides an automation name string for a given line style.

methods.name: GetColorAutomationName
methods.description: Returns an automation name string for a given brush color, considering theme and high contrast.

methods.name: SelectionChanged
methods.description: Event handler for color selection changes, updates SelectedColor and logs the change.

methods.name: OnSelectedColorPropertyChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when SelectedColor property changes, updates UI selection.

methods.name: ColorChooserLoaded
methods.description: Event handler for when the color chooser UI element is loaded, initializes selection.

methods.name: SelectColor
methods.description: Updates UI to reflect the selected color.

methods.name: OnSelectedStylePropertyChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when SelectedStyle property changes, updates UI and logs.

methods.name: SelectStyle
methods.description: Updates UI to reflect the selected line style.

methods.name: StyleChooserBox_SelectionChanged
methods.description: Event handler for line style selection changes.

methods.name: StyleChooserBox_Loaded
methods.description: Event handler for when the style chooser UI element is loaded.
